query:
SELECT DISTINCT p.id, p.created_at
        FROM proposals p
        JOIN legs l ON l.proposal_id = p.id
        WHERE l.from_id = $1
          AND p.state = 'pending'
          AND p.expires_at > now()
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1 FROM approvals a
              WHERE a.proposal_id = p.id AND a.account_id = $1
          )
        ORDER BY p.created_at
